title: Say Anino ed Likod na Trono
intro: Manalalagey ka ed loob na saray korte na sakey a makapanyarin kadaanan a panarian, a ditan et inyabawag na sakey a makapanyarin manuley so inkasikato bilang sakey a dios ed amin a totoo. Diad abay na sayan manuley et akaalagey so sakey a debosyonadon lingkor, ya inmatalek ed saray sankabalgan ya ambisyon na panarian. Saniba iran manplaplano tan manplaplano, ya agda labay ya dengelen iray pasakbay na sakey a mensahero ya imbaki pian mangigiya ed sikara. Sarag mon naamtaan no siopa iyan matoor ya lingkor?
clues: Nanayam ak ed sakey a makapanyarin panarian ya uuleyan na sakey a makapanyarin too ya mangibabagan sikatoy Dios ed amin a totoo.
Nanlingkor ak bilang napanmatalkan a ministro na sayan manuley, ya susumpalen ko so amin ya ambisyon tan ganggan da.
Nen sinmabi so sakey a mensahero nen Allah ed dalin mi ya ontatawag ed sikami ed katuaan, ag kami dinmengel na manuley ko.
Ingganggan ak a mamalang na baleg ya apoy tan mangiparaan na saray laryo a gawad pitek parad baleg a panagpaalagey.
Labay na manoley ko so mangipaalagey na atagey ya istruktura ya anggad tawen a mismo.
Diad kaonuran, say manoley ko, saray sondalo mi, tan siak et nalner tan nalner ed kaaralman na dayat.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Haman
Dhul-Kifl
Jibreel
Mikail
Harut

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Manggawa na tori pian makasabi ed tawen
Say pangibantak ed mandarlang ya apoy
Paliing ed totoo manlapud panagdayew ed saray talintao a bato
Say pangibiig ed bulan bilang madibinon tanda
Panalo ed mabiskeg a syudad diad ganggan na Dios
trial.answer: Manggawa na tori pian makasabi ed tawen

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey a tori ya gawad pinakbet a laryo
Say eges na balyena
Sakey a sagradon subol ed desierto
Sakey a mandarlang a kiew ed masanton palandey
Sakey a biong ya awit na sakey a pinilin pamilya
location.answer: Sakey a tori ya gawad pinakbet a laryo

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Nalner ed kaaralem na dayat
Inyakar ed kaligenan diad sakey a marakdakep a palasyo
Nilaban ed eges na baleg a sira
Nigalangan ed inkaari tan madibinon kakabatan
Nagmaliw ya dabok lapud makapataktakot ya eyag

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
